## Download

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| **HardHatMediaPlayer-{VERSION}-setup-win-x64.exe** | Most people: installs Hard Hat Media Player with a Start menu shortcut and an uninstaller. No admin rights needed. |
| HardHatMediaPlayer-{VERSION}-portable-win-x64.zip | No installation: unzip anywhere and run `HardHatMediaPlayer.exe`. |
| Source code (zip / tar.gz) | Developers: the app's source code. |

Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. Everything needed is included; you don't have to install .NET or VLC.

Windows SmartScreen may warn that the installer is from an unknown publisher, because it isn't code-signed yet:
choose **More info → Run anyway**.

Your library, playlists and settings live in `%APPDATA%\HardHatMediaPlayer` and are kept when you update or
uninstall.
